conjecture: Erdos-Straus: Does 4/n = 1/x + 1/y + 1/z have a positive integer solution for every integer n >= 2

Holroyd-Talbot Conjecture (2005): For any graph G, if 1 ≤ r ≤ μ(G)/2, then G is r-EKR (there exists a vertex v such that the star I^r_v(G) is a maximum intersecting family of independent r-sets), and strictly r-EKR (every maximum intersecting family is a star) when 1 < r < μ(G)/2. Here μ(G) denotes the size of the smallest maximal independent set of G (equivalently, the smallest independent dominating set).
